    Lemma 8.11, Case 2 and the statement #

    Case 2 of lem:opposite-controls: fg = 0 with f q², q² g ≠ 0 is excluded by the seven-object category with arrows u → c → d, u → u', l → c → r, l_d → d and the relation l → c → r = 0 (dimensions 3 at c, 2 at u, d, 1 elsewhere: N = 22, D = 21, F = 1). Indices 0..6 are u' u c d l r l_d.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
